comment: 2026-09-21 regeneration (runner/bin-path resolution, flowsh bind/runner.go v0.4.0 + sp4rk criterion C10 + digest sp4rk-shell-analysis/v4 + severity-first winner selection). The one audited TRUE_DENY of the family, 969588 (npx vitest run /tmp/debug_completion.test.ts -- code from OUTSIDE the session roots), is kept denied deterministically by the NEW hard non-canonical criterion C10 command_exec_outside_roots (a Direct CodeExec/ProcSpawn effect whose path target resolves outside every session root; the exec sibling of C4/C9; marker stays off by its own containment condition) -- previously it survived only as a C6 judge CONFIRM. Winner selection is now severity-first (ties by the fixed priority order), so the hard C10 is never masked by the lower-numbered soft C9.
